type: Prospectively frozen small diagnostic cache/retry follow-up; selected known cases, not an independent accuracy benchmark.
selection: Prior exceptional cache-accounting case, a prior timeout case, an ordinary higher-output holdout case, and a Unicode/numeric-string supplement case. Selected for diagnostics, not a population sample.
ordering: Serial paired blocks. Six original-first and six compressed-first blocks, randomized before execution. Same exact prompt bytes in each repetition.
cache_control: No cache reset, cache busting, manual warmup or verified warm/cold treatment. Earlier requests may affect all repetitions; first repetition is not called cold. Cache metadata is observational and missing values stay unknown.
cost_scope: All attempts, retries and first repetitions included. No paid preparation calls. Matching request IDs plus key-counter reconciliation. Credits are not an invoice; account metadata excluded.

stop_guard.scope: Agent-selected soft stop checked after each completed pair; not a guaranteed ceiling. Authentication/quota failures stop the route; no alternate keys.

candidate_policy: Reuse frozen strings; no instruction changes, output repair, candidate selection or answer-based retesting.
limitations: Four selected known inputs; 12 paired observations are not 12 independent tasks.
Cache state is inferred from gateway-reported metadata, not directly controlled or authenticated.
One gateway model label, not a verified upstream provider model.
Small observational follow-up cannot establish that compression causes cache changes or timeouts.
Original-only default and earlier cost rejection remain unchanged.
